{{Top|leg}}
'''Sanohb'I''' was the summer equinox on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Socorro/Legends|Socorro]] which lasted for seventy-two [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]]. During the Sanohb'I, the planet's temperature rose to its highest levels.<ref name="BSS">''[[The Black Sands of Socorro]]''</ref>
